info.title: Tokenless daemon HTTP API
info.description: Local loopback daemon HTTP API. Every daemon route, readiness proof, error envelope, job payload, and browser runtime control response belongs to this OpenAPI contract.

servers.description: Preferred loopback origin. The daemon may bind a higher free port and records the actual origin in local SQLite runtime state.

get.summary: Read token-bound daemon readiness proof without auth

200.description: Browser runtime status after quiesce request

post.summary: Open a managed profile in the embedded browser runtime without provider navigation
Request supported provider home pages as one background-tab batch in a managed profile

200.description: Accepted provider background-tab requests; page loading continues asynchronously

post.summary: Bind one configured provider and managed profile for Web AI Interaction Protocol V0

200.description: Opaque provider binding and static capability projection

get.summary: Read the binding's static Web AI capability projection

200.description: Opaque provider binding and static capability projection

post.summary: Stream one bounded markdown system prompt into an opaque staged attachment
Atomically consume a staged attachment and queue one V0 turn

get.summary: Read one core V0 turn state without exposing a daemon job

post.summary: Cancel one V0 turn by opaque turn reference
Durably cancel a V0 request intent before or after its opaque turn reference is known

200.description: Strict cancellation outcome with no job, profile, URL, path, or provider details

get.summary: Resolve an exact provider Project and optional task conversation mapping

200.description: Exact provider Project mapping, with a task-scoped conversation when requested

get.summary: Resolve a provider conversation by exact profile and task scope
Project the next prompt against known provider capacity

post.summary: Request graceful daemon shutdown using bearer authentication

404.description: Shutdown route is not mounted by runtimes that use http_router(store); Axum may return its default 404 body.

post.summary: Mark one addressed job outcome revision as reported

200.description: Idempotent report receipt and public job view

post.summary: Atomically report pending outcome summaries for one agent recipient
post.description: Eligible outcome revisions are marked reported in SQLite before this response is returned. A lost response is not replayed automatically; full job state remains queryable by job ID.

controlBearer.description: Bearer token read from the daemon home control token file. /ready is a public challenge endpoint; /control/shutdown uses bearer authentication after the CLI verifies /ready for the same home.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request body, path, query, or daemon input

Forbidden.description: Rejected bearer token or claim token

NotFound.description: Job or routed endpoint not found

Conflict.description: Claim lease or job state conflict

WebAiRequestRefConflict.description: The immutable requestRef is already bound to a different Web AI V0 start request; no new turn or job was created.

WebAiRequestRefStartConflict.description: The immutable requestRef is already bound to a different request or was cancelled before a turn could be created.

message.const: The request reference is already bound to a different request.
The request reference was cancelled before a turn could be created.
